 THIS CRIMINAL MISC. CASE HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 20.01.2023, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY PASSED THE FOLLOWING:
 Crl.M.C.No.326/23 3  ORDER Petitioners are the accused Nos.1 to 4 in Crime No.270 of 2016 of Paravoor Police Station, which is now pending as c.c.No.21 of 2020 on the file of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Paravoor.

sentences.text: 2. Offences alleged against the petitioners are under Sections 420, 468, 471 read with Section 34 of IPC.
Respondents 3 and 4 are the victims of the crime.
Annexure-1 is the final report submitted by the Police and this Crl.M.C. is filed for quashing all further proceedings pursuant to the same.

3. Heard Sri.V.A.Vinod, learned counsel for the petitioners, Sri.M.P.Prashanth, learned Public Prosecutor for the State and Sri.Shakthi Prakash, learned counsel for the respondents 3 and 4.
4. Prayer for quashing the proceedings is sought mainly on the ground that the dispute between the parties has been settled. Annexures-2 and 3 affidavits sworn by the 3 rd and 4th respondents are filed along with this Crl.M.C. to substantiate the settlement.

In the said affidavit, the 3rd and 4th respondents had specifically acknowledged the aforesaid settlement and also conveyed the no- Radhakrishnan vs State Of Kerala on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/125619531/
2 objection to quash the proceedings against the petitioners herein.
The learned counsel appearing for the 3rd and 4th respondents also confirms the same.
The learned Public Prosecutor, upon instructions, submitted that the Station House Officer concerned has verified the veracity of the same and found it to be genuine.
5. The allegations would reveal that the dispute is purely private in nature.

In such circumstances,
by applying the principles laid down by the Honourable Supreme Court in Gian Singh v. State of Punjab and Another [(2012) 10 SCC 303], proceedings can be quashed by invoking the powers of this Court under Section 482 Cr.P.C.

entities.text: Gian Singh v. State of Punjab and Another [(2012) 10 SCC 303]
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: This is particularly because, on account of the settlement, no fruitful purpose would be served by allowing the prosecution to continue.

In the result, this Crl.M.C. is allowed, and Annexure-A1 FIR submitted in Crime No.270 of 2016 of Paravoor Police Station and all further proceedings in C.C.No.21 of 2020 on the file of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Paravoor, against the petitioners are hereby quashed.
